explanation: It is often translated as land of the long white cloud. The English name comes from Zeeland, a Dutch province, via the Latin Nova Zeelandia on Dutch maps.

claims.text: Aotearoa is the Māori name for New Zealand.
Samoa, Fiji and Tonga are separate Pacific countries; Fiji's own name in Fijian is Viti.
Aotearoa is often translated as 'land of the long white cloud'.
New Zealand is named after Zeeland, a province of the Netherlands, through the Latin Nova Zeelandia used by Dutch map-makers.
